annotations.title: Statutory demand deadline calculator (Insolvency Act 1986 ss.123 and 268; IR 2016)

description: Works out the statutory demand and petition timetable in England and Wales: on a company (Insolvency Act 1986 s.123(1)(a): 3 weeks to pay, secure or compound, then a winding-up petition) or on an individual (s.268: 18 days to apply to set the demand aside under IR 2016 r.10.4, 21 days to comply, then a bankruptcy petition for at least £5,000), with personal service and CPR 6.26, a set-aside application stopping the clock, the four-month rule, service of the petition (CPR 6.14), the Gazette notice, the certificate of compliance, notices of opposition and of intention to appear, and the court fee and official receiver's deposit. For a company, business days leave out Scotland's bank holidays too (s.251). Demands served abroad are not covered. Says where a date rests on a reading.

abroad.description: "individual": the demand was served outside England and Wales (not covered: the periods differ, IR 2016 r.10.1(10)).

amount.description: The sum demanded (optional), for the £750 company and £5,000 bankruptcy thresholds, in pounds, e.g. "12500" or "12,500.50".

debtor.description: Who the demand is served on: "company" (a company: winding up), "individual" (an individual: bankruptcy).

hearing.description: The date of the hearing of the petition (YYYY-MM-DD).

method.description: "individual": how the demand was served (default personal): "personal" (handed to the debtor personally), "acknowledged" (service acknowledged in writing), "certificate" (another way (date in the certificate of service)).

orderFrom.description: Where setAside is "dismissed-hearing": the date in the order from which a petition may be presented, if it gives one (YYYY-MM-DD).

petitionServed.description: The day the petition was handed over ("individual") or served at the registered office ("company") (YYYY-MM-DD).

presented.description: The date the petition was presented (YYYY-MM-DD).

served.description: "company": the day the demand was left at the registered office. "individual": the day it was served (see method) (YYYY-MM-DD).

servedTime.description: "individual", served personally: the time it was handed over, for CPR 6.26 (24-hour HH:MM). Leave out if not known.

setAside.description: "individual": any application to set the demand aside: "" (no application, or not known), "pending" (applied, not yet decided), "dismissed-papers" (dismissed without a hearing), "dismissed-hearing" (dismissed at a hearing), "set-aside" (the demand was set aside).

setAsideDecided.description: "individual": the date the application was dismissed, or the demand set aside (YYYY-MM-DD).

setAsideFiled.description: "individual": the date the application to set the demand aside was filed (YYYY-MM-DD).
